1: Serologic testing for anti–nuclear antigen, anti–aminoacyl–tRNA synthetase, anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide, anti-Sjögren’s-syndrome-related antigen A and B, and anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antigen antibodies were all negative.
2: He had no history of antigen exposure.
3: He received lascufloxacin and then tazobactam/ceftolozane without improvement; oxygen requirement increased to 2 L/min.
5: Transbronchial lung biopsy showed no malignancy
6: cultures of bronchoscopy specimens were negative.
7: Based on the clinical picture and imaging, grade 3 ICI-induced pneumonitis was suspected.
8: He underwent methylprednisolone 1000 mg/day for 3 days followed by prednisolone 60 mg/day for 8 days, but chest radiographs remained unchanged and oxygen needs rose to 4 L/min.
A second course of methylprednisolone 1000 mg/day for 3 days produced no clinical improvement.
